class.name: OcgBrepmeshDelaun
class.brief_description: Compute the Delaunay's triangulation with the algorithm of Watson.
class.description: ! Compute the Delaunay's triangulation with the algorithm of Watson.

method.name: from_4
method.description: Creates instance of triangulator, but do not run the algorithm automatically.

method.name: InitCirclesTool
method.description: Forces initialization of circles cell filter using working structure.

method.name: RemoveVertex
method.description: Removes a vertex from the triangulation.

method.name: UseEdge
method.description: Modify mesh to use the edge.

method.name: ProcessConstraints
method.description: Forces insertion of constraint edges into the base triangulation.

method.name: GetVertex
method.description: Gives vertex with the given index

method.name: GetEdge
method.description: Gives edge with the given index

method.name: GetTriangle
method.description: Gives triangle with the given index

method.name: Circles
method.description: Returns tool used to build mesh consistent to Delaunay criteria.

method.name: Contains
method.description: Test is the given triangle contains the given vertex.

method.name: RemoveAuxElements
method.description: Destruction of auxiliary triangles containing the given vertices. Removes auxiliary vertices also.
